events.text: Please share which gate doors you know are safe, especially gate 1, so we can coordinate the approved route.
A1 knows gate 4: right and gate 5: left. I do not know gate 1; please share if you do.
A2 knows gate 1: left and gate 7: right. I will take gate 1 left; please share any known safe doors for gates 2, 3, 6, and 8.
A2 reports gate 1 left. I know gate 2 right and gate 8 right. A1 knows gate 4 right and gate 5 left. Proceed with those safe doors in gate order.
A1 will take gate 1 left, as confirmed by A2. Continue sharing safe doors for gates 3 and 6.
A2 will take gate 2 right, as reported by A3. Continue sharing safe doors for gates 3 and 6.
Gate 1 left and gate 2 right are confirmed safe. I will proceed through gate 1 left, then gate 2 right.

A1: Round 1: I know gate 4 is right and gate 5 is left. Gate 1 is unknown, so I should not guess.
Round 2: A2 has confirmed gate 1 left is safe. Take the approved safe door.
A2: Round 1: I know gate 1 is left and gate 7 is right. Share both facts, then take the safe gate 1 left door. Use second action to look around for gate 2 information.
Round 2: Gate 2 safe door is right, reported by A3. Proceed through it, then inspect surroundings for further information.
A3: Round 1: A2 knows gate 1 is left; I know gates 2 and 8 are right. Avoid attempting gate 1 until coordinated. Use one action to inspect surroundings.
Round 2: Use approved route only; service tunnel is unauthorized and should not be used. Gate 1 left is confirmed by A2. Gate 2 right is confirmed by me.
A4: Round 1: At gate 1, unknown safe door. Request other robots share gate knowledge; use look_around as first action to gather information.
